ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Service DACL Modification Via Set-Service Cmdlet - PS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the "Set-Service" powershell cmdlet to configure a new SecurityDescriptor that allows a service to be hidden from other utilities such as "sc.exe", "Get-Service"...etc. (Works only in powershell 7) Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-SecurityDescriptorSddl\\ .*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-sd\\ .*")) AND ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-Service\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*D\\;\\;.*")) AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\;\\;\\;IU.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\;\\;\\;SU.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\;\\;\\;BA.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\;\\;\\;SY.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\;\\;\\;WD.*"))))
